phases.name: Execution Baseline
phases.goal: Fix MVP boundaries and ownership before implementation
actions: Confirm immutable decisions for MVP
Assign owner and reviewer for each next phase
Lock acceptance criteria and gate checks
checks: Each phase has owner and measurable acceptance criteria
phases.rollback: Freeze and return to design if conflicts are found

phases.name: GUI Skeleton and State Orchestrator
phases.goal: Build navigable UI skeleton and deterministic state transitions
actions: Define main UI zones and actions
Define workflow states and transitions
Guard invalid actions by state
checks: Invalid actions are blocked by guards
phases.expected_result: Stable GUI skeleton with controlled state machine
phases.rollback: Reduce to minimal finite state set if instability appears

phases.name: Project Scan and Reference Selection
phases.goal: Discover images recursively and validate exactly three references
actions: Implement recursive image discovery within selected project root
Create preview-ready data stream
Enforce selection guard exactly 3 references
checks: Generate action is blocked unless selection count is 3
phases.rollback: Fallback to on-demand preview flow if caching is unstable

phases.name: ProxyAPI Contract Integration
phases.goal: Integrate text prompt shaping and image edits generation contracts
actions: Validate environment contract before first request
Implement text prompt shaping request
Implement images/edits request with three references
Map API errors to user-safe categories
checks: Retry only for retryable error classes
phases.rollback: Use deterministic local prompt template when text-shaping is unavailable

phases.name: Generation Review and Regeneration Loop
actions: Generate default set of three mockups
Render generated preview set
Support regenerate with same selected references
checks: Only one active generation request at a time
phases.rollback: Serialize generation operations by single request lock

phases.name: Save and README Insert
phases.goal: Save selected PNG outputs and update README marker section
actions: Save selected mockups to <project>/output/mockups/
Ensure deterministic file naming policy
Update marker section inside README.md
checks: Saved files are readable and referenced correctly
README update is restricted to marker section
phases.expected_result: Complete output and documentation insertion pipeline
phases.rollback: Create README backup before write and restore on failure

phases.name: Hardening and Error Paths
phases.goal: Close reliability and safety baseline for MVP
actions: Implement bounded timeout and retry behavior
Implement file-size and decode safety guards
Ensure logs exclude secrets and base64 payloads
checks: No secret leakage in logs and UI errors
phases.expected_result: Stable behavior under invalid inputs and network faults
phases.rollback: Revert to stricter defaults for limits and disable risky optional branches

phases.name: E2E Acceptance
actions: Run full happy path and key negative paths
Collect QA and role-based review reports
Approve release readiness or route back by defect owner
checks: No blocker or critical findings remain open
phases.expected_result: Release candidate readiness for coding completion
phases.rollback: Return to source phase of failed scenario and rerun acceptance
